A successful actual release.yml run consumes that exact rehearsal receipt, creates only v0.5.50, and proves tag target, provider Release, assets, checksums/digests, SBOM/provenance, installer identity, and final strict smoke against the same source identity.
Issue #625 is corrected from its stale v0.5.49 wording to v0.5.50 and closed only after publication facts are independently verified.

The Work Item emits a visible green or yellow/red Outcome as evidence dictates, completes archive/PR/merge/ai-close-work-item, and final audit reports no open implementation PRs or unresolved release issues.

guidelines: Use only the authoritative release workflow for immutable provider mutations; do not create tags or Releases manually.
Preserve strict readiness → same-SHA rehearsal → actual release ordering and fail closed on any identity mismatch.
Treat Outcome as the user-facing operation interface: record completed work, failed gate/recovery, and hosted evidence truthfully.

intent.problem: All remediation Work Items, including strict smoke concurrency isolation and deterministic red Outcome generation, are merged and closed. The repository must now publish the next valid successor without repeating the previous v0.5.49 misidentification or releasing from stale/unrehearsed source evidence.
constraints: Start from the latest synchronized origin/main SHA after #772 and keep the Work Item branch separate from the published source.
Release only v0.5.50, only via release.yml, and only after a same-SHA rehearsal receipt and the workflow's own exact-source validations pass.
Do not modify source, release projections, workflows, tags, or provider Releases by hand.
Correct and close #625 only after independent provider-side verification; do not conceal failures with a green claim.
intent.rationale: A release is a high-impact external operation. Binding readiness, rehearsal, publication, and post-publication validation to one immutable default-branch source protects users while keeping the final human interface clear and recoverable.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized automatic execution and asked that this authority be recorded in every Work Item Contract; restricted writes are limited to this Contract, Summary, generated status, starts/archive/outcome evidence, and the authoritative provider release workflow's external v0.5.50 publication.

rollbackNote: Do not retag or delete the immutable published version. If publication fails before promotion, preserve provider diagnostics and leave the Work Item active with a red Outcome; if it succeeds, repair only through a distinct governed corrective Work Item.
